criteria.statement: HeartbeatObservation records worker pubkey, observed time, sequence, interval, and expiry duration.
HeartbeatMonitor stores observations in memory with RWMutex protection and reports snapshots by worker pubkey.
Observations are deduplicated by sequence, with lower sequences ignored and equal sequences keeping the later observation time.
Sequence zero observations use observed-at monotonic comparison.
Freshness status is derived from observation age and expiry, defaulting expiry to three times the interval, and expired workers can be listed deterministically.
